INNER HEAD. [3] [Aloe]
Headache across forehead, with heaviness of eyes and nausea.
Headaches < from heat, > from cold applications.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Aloe]
He has to hurry to closet immediately after eating and drinking. θ Colic.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Aloe]
Sensation of fulness, heaviness ; heat and inflammation.
Discharge of much flatulency, burning, smelling offensive, relieving pain in abdomen ; after each meal, in evening and morning, before stool.
Great and cutting-griping pain in right and lower portion of abdomen, which was excruciating before and during stool ; after stool all pains ceased, leaving profuse sweating and extreme weakness. θ Colic.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Aloe]
Hemorrhoids : protrude like a bunch of grapes ; constant bearing down in rectum ; bleeding ; sore, tender, hot ; relieved by cold water.
   

NERVES. [36] [Aloe]
Extreme prostration, with perspiration.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Aloe]
Old people. θ Colic and diarrhœa.
